title: Lorentzian metrics in contrast
summary: Non-degenerate metrics of signature (−,+,+,+): Minkowski space and Lorentz transformations (Sternberg chapter 7); causal character of vectors and curves, proper time and the reverse triangle inequality; which constructions carry over verbatim (Levi-Civita connection, Christoffel symbols, curvature tensor, divergence on a semi-Riemannian manifold) and which fail (distance function, Hopf–Rinow, existence via partitions of unity); the standing convention of this course restated.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is Sternberg chapter 7 (§7.1 two-dimensional Lorentz transformations, §7.2 Minkowski space) and §8.1 (divergence and Lie derivative on a semi-Riemannian manifold), with Lee chapter 2 (Pseudo-Riemannian Metrics, p. 40) and chapter 3 (Model Pseudo-Riemannian Manifolds) as the commercial reference. The primary Lund notes do not treat indefinite metrics.

preparation.description: Read Sternberg chapter 7, §7.1 (two-dimensional Lorentz transformations, proper time, the reverse triangle inequality) and §7.2 (Minkowski space), pp. 133–152.
Read Sternberg §8.1 (pp. 157–166): densities, divergence on a semi-Riemannian manifold, the Lie derivative of a semi-Riemann metric, to see the Riemannian formalism carried to indefinite signature.
Optional, if you have the book: Lee chapter 2, section 'Pseudo-Riemannian Metrics', and chapter 3, 'Model Pseudo-Riemannian Manifolds'.

activities.title: Minkowski space and semi-Riemannian geometry
activities.instructions: Read the notes for this unit. The prepared lesson, tutorial and exercises are not yet written; this outline shows exactly what the unit will cover. Keep the signature convention of each source in view: Sternberg's and Lee's may differ from each other and from the (−,+,+,+) used here.
